item.title: Bulletin updated at 00:00 HKT 29/Dec/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A dry northeast monsoon will bring generally fine weather to the coast of southern China today. It will be rather cool in the morning over the region and cold over inland areas. With the monsoon moderating early this week, daytime temperatures over Guangdong will rise slightly. A fresh easterly airstream is expected to affect the coast of Guangdong midweek this week. The weather will be mild with sunny periods during the day over the region. Under the influence of another surge of the northeast monsoon, the weather will become cool over the coast of southern China in the latter part of this week.
